title: economic_propagation.propagation_hypothesis/v1
description: K3-D Economic Propagation hypothesis record. One governed, display/research-tier object that composes existing Graph 1 (economic relationship), Graph 2 (fundamental/narrative similarity) and Graph 3 (residual market) OWNER evidence into a provenance-rich read-through hypothesis — or a typed abstention when Graph-1 relationship, exact identity, rights, clocks or coverage are insufficient. This record is the general form of the architecture-only join object earnings_readthrough_hypothesis/v1 (research/EARNINGS_NEURAL_GRAPH_READTHROUGH_AND_CATALYST_ARCHITECTURE_2026-08-16.md §2.6; unowned and unimplemented at freeze time — census in the K3-D freeze doc). It is NEVER a store, a graph, an edge type, a score, a rank, a grade, a gate, a size, or a trade signal. BINDING KILLS carried in-body via binding_kills: DNR:KILL-PSS-SR2-PEER-DIFFUSION (peer new-low diffusion construction closed; adverse on every outcome layer); DNR:KILL-PSS-SR3-PARTICIPATION (the participation construction was KILLED, not merely demoted to display — any future peer-state species must measure an ORTHOGONAL source of durable absorption or selective leadership, never another contemporaneous sector-breadth relief label; in this contract peer participation/breadth alone can NEVER admit a target); DNR:KILL-CN-SUPPLY-ABSORPTION (price-only absorption is momentum; cannot be reconstituted from broad participation or co-movement); DNR:KILL-CAUSAL-DAG-ALPHA (no discovered-graph causal alpha; this record is hypothesis/evidence tier with zero authority). Graph 2/3 evidence may never launder a missing Graph-1 economic relationship. economic_share remains formula-unowned and MUST be null. Grading, if ever wanted, routes through engine/grading.py and existing forward ledgers — this contract owns no grade ledger.

record_id.description: Deterministic identity: sha256 over (source_event.event_id, target.requested_key, asof), first 16 hex chars. Same inputs -> same record_id, always.

binding_kills.description: The four kill receipts every K3-D record acknowledges. Const so no caller can drop or amend them.

asof.description: Composition cutoff. Evidence known after this cutoff must not participate (validator K3D_R061; applies to leg/admission asof+known_at, source event clocks, and BOTH identity resolution_asof values). Clock comparison is DATE-granular by declared law: evidence known intraday on the cutoff date counts as knowable at the cutoff.

compiled_at.description: Caller-supplied compile clock. The library never reads a wall clock; determinism law.

requested_key.description: The caller's raw key (ticker, GMI node id, name). NEVER an identity by itself.

generator_admissions.description: Which generator admitted this target into consideration, tagged with its graph. An admitted-by-Graph-2 target stays Graph-2-admitted even if a Graph-3 move also exists. Generators must exist in contracts/economic_propagation/generator_registry.v1.json; a registry row with admits_target=false (peer participation/breadth) can never appear here.

relationship_paths.description: Graph 1 ONLY: why transfer could occur. Role-specific, owner-backed.

similarity_evidence.description: Graph 2 ONLY: what operating information is comparable. Never a cash-flow edge.

market_evidence.description: Graph 3 ONLY: how the market is treating the names. Cannot be inverted into economic cause.

graph_1.description: COMPILER-DERIVED from relationship_paths. Absence is unknown_unavailable, never false-relationship and never zero.

hypothesis_text.description: Operating-mechanism prose. No price forecast, no trade direction (validator K3D_R041). Null whenever state=abstained.

predicted_operating_direction.description: Direction of the OPERATING metric only — never predicted price return or trade direction. Null whenever state=abstained.

hypothesis_state.description: COMPILER-DERIVED headline, unified with abstention: supported_hypothesis if and only if abstention.abstained=false (which itself requires graph_1=supported, effective admissions, and a hypothesized mechanism). A record can never be simultaneously supported and abstained.

reasons.description: Typed, closed, and every value is compiler-reachable: stale/superseded legs derive stale_owner_object and not_yet_knowable legs derive correction_not_yet_knowable — evidence that exists but is unusable at the cutoff is never misreported as no_graph1_evidence (that reason is reserved for ZERO Graph-1 legs). Empty exactly when abstained=false.

alternatives.description: Competing explanations are mandatory on every record, including abstentions.

falsifiers.description: Observable invalidation conditions. Internal/research tier — falsifier language never surfaces on user cycle pages (operator 2026-07-27).

expiry.description: Every hypothesis carries a review clock; nothing is evergreen.

authority.description: All authority axes are const-false. There is no lawful way to emit an authoritative K3-D record.

economic_share.description: Reserved formula-unowned axis. MUST be null until its canonical owner mints a formula (GMI W2 verdict). K3-D may not invent one.

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical serialization of this record with content_sha256 blanked. Deterministic-repeat law.

owner_program.description: Closed set of recognized native owners. K3-D reads them; it never writes them.

coverage_state.description: Derived from the actual owner objects, never from field names or nominal source meaning.

usability_state.description: Only usable legs support graph states. Every other value is a typed non-usable state.

resolution_state.description: Data OS / Stock Identity verdict, carrying the OWNER vocabulary as observed in production (gmi.identity_resolution/v1 emits RESOLVED / NOT_IN_MASTER / UNSUPPORTED_MARKET / DEFERRED_IDENTITY_EXCEPTION / ENTITY_TYPE_CONFLICT; UNRESOLVED and CONFLICTING are the contract's generic forms). Anything but RESOLVED forces typed abstention before any semantic inference.

construct.description: Closed construct vocabulary. Every construct carries a fixed graph assignment in generator_registry.v1.json construct_vocabulary; a leg claiming a graph its construct does not belong to is laundering (K3D_R032).

role_evidence_class.description: What the SOURCE actually supports. agreement_role_unknown (e.g. a generic 8-K agreement or financing-agent counterparty) can only carry role=role_unknown — never customer/supplier (K3D_R031). identity_only (ownership without cash-flow-rights change) supports no economic role.

comparability_basis.description: Explains comparability, NOT a customer/supplier relationship.

market_state_basis.description: How the market is treating the names right now. Can exist with no Graph-1 path; cannot be inverted into economic cause.
